title: Let’s review what we learned
intro: Adam (AS), Allah, the angels, the books, the Qur’an, qadar, Salah and the pillars of Islam – let’s repeat.

learn.html: Let’s repeat what we have learned so far this year. Try the activities, then answer the questions with your muallim.

items: Allah, the Most High, ________ Adam (AS) from ________, and breathed into him a ________. Then He commanded the ________ to make sajdah to him, and they did. With them was Iblis, who ________, became arrogant and became ________.
Allah alone is worthy of our ________ and worship; only to Him we ________ and only from Him we ________. He has 99 ________, and His own name is ________.

The Qur’an is Allah’s ________ revelation, sent to His last Messenger ________ (SAW). It began on the night of ________ in the month of ________ in the year ____, in the cave of ________ on Mount ________. It was revealed over ____ years: ____ in Makkah and ____ in Madinah. It has ____ surahs and over ____ thousand ayahs, in ____ juz’.
Once the companions asked about qadar, and the Prophet (SAW) said: “Know that what reached you could not have ________ you, and what missed you could not have ________ you.”
When was Salah given to the believers, and who showed in practice how to pray it?
When do we make sajdat as-sahw, and how?
Which part of Salah do we make up, and which not?
What is fasting? What is zakah? What is Hajj?
What is the first pillar of iman? What are the sifat?
Write what you know about the last Messenger, Muhammad (SAW).

Takes the soul from the body

practice.title: True or false?
practice.prompt: Tap every sentence that is TRUE, then tap Check.

options.text: The Tawrat was revealed to Musa (AS).
The Zabur was revealed to Shith (AS).
options.why: The Zabur was revealed to Dawud (AS).

options.text: The Injil was revealed to Idris (AS).
The Qur’an was not revealed to Muhammad (SAW).
options.why: The Qur’an was revealed to Muhammad (SAW).
The messengers were people chosen by Allah.

options.text: The akhirah is a world that does not last for ever.
Death is the end, and there is nothing after it.
options.why: After death comes the barzakh and then the akhirah.

practice.title: The Shahadah in order
practice.prompt: Put the words of the Shahadah in the right order.

practice.title: Making up prayers – true or false?
practice.prompt: Tap every sentence that is TRUE, then tap Check.

options.text: When I make up Fajr on the same day after sunrise, I pray both the sunnah and the fard.
When I miss a prayer, I make up the sunnah first and then the fard.
options.why: We make up only the fard (and witr) – except the sunnah of Fajr on the same day.

options.text: I make up eight missed prayers before the prayer of the time.
options.why: With six or more missed prayers, we pray the prayer of the time first.
